meaning:
Μαδιάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִדְיָן),
Midian;
1. son of Abraham (Gen.25:2).
2. An Arabian tribe (Gen.36:35, Psa.83:9, al).
3. γῆ Μ. (Heb. מִדְיָן אֶרֶץ), the land of Midian (Exo.2:15, al.): Act.7:29.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
